config:
[apps]
quit=["Quit Demo"]
freeze=["Freeze Demo"]
skip=["Skip Demo"]
ask=["Ask Demo"]
default="skip"
[[apps.with_daemon]]
name="Remote Demo"
group="network"
system_daemons=["<ROOT>/org.demo.daemon.plist"]
[network]
apps=["Network Demo", "Remote Demo"]
[services]
unload=["org.demo.worker"]
[options]
language="en"
labels: SleepDisabled=1 (sleep disabled globally; closing the lid will not sleep)
caffeinate prevents sleep: PID 919999: /usr/bin/caffeinate -d; parent PID 919997: /Applications/Terminal.app/Contents/MacOS/Terminal
Audio assertion: "audio" (quit the app playing audio to release it)
